elevation.cropSampleConvention: Grid sample coordinates are source pixel centres; no half-pixel shift is lost.
elevation.sourceGdalMetadata:
<GDALMetadata>
  <Item name="VERTICAL_DATUM">EGM2008/EPSG:3855</Item>
  <Item name="OFFSET" sample="0" role="offset">0</Item>
  <Item name="SCALE" sample="0" role="scale">0.100000000000000006</Item>
</GDALMetadata>
elevation.scalingApplied: Native Float32 values are used as physical metres (scale=1), following the official v1.2 Float32/metres documentation and same-pixel Copernicus comparison. Exported crop scale=1.
elevation.sourceMetadataConflict: The v1.2 source carries GDAL SCALE=0.1 although native Float32 values already match physical metres. A stale pre-conversion tag is inferred, not a provider-confirmed correction. Applying it would shrink local elevations tenfold. Original metadata and native compressed bytes are preserved.
elevation.sourcePeriod: 2006–2015 raster source period; machine-learning bare-earth estimate using newer laser-altimetry training, not a current field survey
elevation.limitations: Approximately 30 m global ML terrain estimate; does not measure pavement camber, kerbs, road steps, small mounds or speed-bump geometry. Buildings/trees are estimated away, not perfectly removed.
elevation.attribution: Ho, Y.-F., Grohmann, C.H., Lindsay, J., Reuter, H.I., Parente, L., Witjes, M., Hengl, T. (2025). GEDTM30, PeerJ 13:e19673. https://doi.org/10.7717/peerj.19673. GEDTM30 v1.2, OpenGeoHub / OpenTopography, CC BY 4.0. Crop and resampling by KAISTCart.

provenance.course: Road-only adaptation of KAIST Fun Run waypoints; not the official pedestrian route or a measured road corridor.

campusDetails.filter: Retained amenity=parking ways and referenced nodes, natural=tree nodes only; roadway/building data remains the prior snapshot.
campusDetails.note: Mapped surface parking polygons and individual tree nodes only; this is not a complete tree inventory.
